Therefore, we use Relative Slot Accuracy (RSA), which can be regarded as a soft version of JGA and can better distinguish models. It is calculated as |Bt∩B′t|/|S|, where |Bt∩B′t| is the number of correctly predicted slots and |S| is the number of unique slots in Bt∪B′t.
